messages:
ana (product): Heads-up, client MercuryPay reported a throughput/latency regression after last night's model rollout. Putting immediate triage on the table. @tom @omar can you look?

mei (support): Case SUP-4910. Symptom: p95 for chat endpoints increased from ~220ms to ~720ms for long prompts (~1k tokens). Customer on Dedicated with sustained qps ~150. Spike began 2025-11-10T23:05Z right after deploy-bot finished.

deploy-bot: rollout v2.7 (model/galactica-70b-quant) completed at 2025-11-10T23:03:17Z :package:

tom (eng-runtime): I'll fetch traces and kernel switch logs. Quick question: are they using convo-history and KV prefix caching? Also, what's their typical batch size?

mei (support): MercuryPay uses convo-history, enabled prefix/KV cache, batch_size=1 (they disable batching). Long prompts are common.

omar (eng-platform): Quick mitigation options:
- Tenant-level rollback to previous model (fast)
- Route tenant to smaller quant variant (galactica-70b-q4f)
- Apply routing transform to chop sequences >512 (risk: changes outputs)
Rolling back is simplest but may roll back improvements for other tenants.

priya (sales): MercuryPay is enterprise, SLA clauses apply. They want a mitigation within 12h and status updates every 2h. We should prioritize.

tom (eng-runtime): Initial trace look: there's a new attention kernel in v2.7 that defers fused-kv path for sequences >512 when convo_history present. That causes kernel mismatch and extra memcpy. I can repro with a 1k-token request and see the p95 jump locally.

ana (product): (typo correction) ana (product): Proposed quick plan:
1) Apply tenant routing override to galactica-70b-v2.6 for MercuryPay (omar) now.
2) Create backlog PROD-6589: "Investigate v2.7 attention/KV ordering regression" (owner: tom). Acceptance: reproduce, add CI regression test for seq>512, implement automatic variant fallback when fused-KV not selected, and update runbook + customer comms.
3) Priority: P1. Mitigation ETA: 45m. Full RCA and fix target: 72h.

omar (eng-platform): I can enact the tenant override in ~20m. Suggest also setting a tenant p95 alert at 400ms so support can watch.

mei (support): I'll update SUP-4910 with workaround and ETA, ask customer for exact request examples to replay.

omar (eng-platform): Applying route override tenant=mercurypay-02 -> model=galactica-70b-v2.6. Rule id: route-ov-9121.

deploy-bot: applied route override route-ov-9121 at 2025-11-10T23:42:07Z :white_check_mark:

tom (eng-runtime): Local replay after route change shows p95 back to ~240ms. Still running full repro. I'll open the PROD-6589 ticket and assign.

ana (product): (again typo) ana: Thanks. I'll draft the customer note and coordinate the 30-min post-mitigation bridge. Priya, please lead comms.

priya (sales): On it. I'll send initial update and schedule the bridge.

mei (support): :thumbsup: SUP-4910 patched. Will attach latency graphs post-override.

ana (product): Follow-ups: tom to own root cause + fix; omar to own mitigation automation for tenant-scoped rollbacks; support to collect customer replay traffic. Product to set launch criteria for the fix (RCA, regression test, fallback policy).
